Search around uses two equal columns (48% basis with grow1); compact chips use the existing small font, one line and padding4/gap4 while preserving 48-unit targets. Current search is fully visible at 320. The 10-km chip wrapping at 320 is an accepted scrollable advisory. Filters renders only section headers and control labels: Diet, Vegetarian, Vegan, Allium-free, Cuisine, Price, Saved only, Search around and Distance. No Allium caption, diet legend, Google explanation or Home/Work help paragraph is shown. The Allium-free row has a 48-unit minimum target (observed 50). Auto-save/apply, private-address setup and functional loading/error/Retry states remain. Explore now controls location messages with Settings, Retry and Dismiss recovery. Location service preflight and an explicit foreground tap retain a 20-second timeout, cancellation, and owner/route/manual-edit guards; manual search remains available. Cuisine keywords, Google venue price bands 1–4 and Saved only auto-save/apply with the existing diet, Allium-free, Search around and Distance controls. Every immediate search and accepted-context comparison includes cuisine/price; the server validates inputs and post-filters Google price levels. Cuisine is keyword relevance, not reviewed classification; venue price bands are not exact SGD or dish prices. Saved only filters saved places within the current search matches. Empty results offer Widen area and Filters; provider/offline feedback stays short with Retry. Filters has labels/headers only, with no Apply, Reset or explanatory copy. Explore cards represent venues and now expose approved Menu navigation; private Home/Work boundaries remain.
discoveryPatterns.acceptance: Current consumer Menu: seven source groups, six browser journeys, 18 captures (17 unique), four scoped axe surfaces with zero definite violations, zero page errors/paid Google calls; TypeScript/lint exit0 and source reviews approved. Managed headless Chromium156; no installed Chrome. Native transport200 with private keys/server/research excluded; appearance/deployment/fullAA unverified. Substitute finish review ships the reviewed React Native Web/source scope: F01 resolved, 17 required images individually inspected/valid, no material fixes remain. Physical-device/deployment/full-app AA acceptance stays unverified. Prior footer/gallery reports remain scoped historical evidence.
discoveryPatterns.details: Live place details use a horizontal paging GooglePhotoGallery: only visible/visited photos load, dots show 1/N, and swipe, keyboard and native adjustable actions select photos. Tapping a photo opens the existing viewer; no zoom icon or Photo N selection buttons remain. The compact author/source row below the gallery is removed; matching credits remain in the full-screen exact-photo viewer. Explanatory paragraphs (including Share), ingredient-evidence/Ask-the-stall blocks and private notes remain removed from live place details. Approved Menu entries now open their separate selected-item page below the primary actions. Save, Directions, Share, Call, hours, website and reviews remain. Equal adjacent bordered icon-and-label Correction and Report concern controls are 52 units tall and open the existing forms. Sample/cooking ingredient evidence and other private collection data remain separate. Detail hours/rating use a single compact shrinking/ellipsized row at narrow widths. The gallery retains native accessibilityValue and uses targeted web ARIA range props for React Native Web. GooglePhotoGallery removes its compact author/source row and uses24-unit pagination. The full-screen exact-photo viewer retains matching original credits. Live place details omit the standalone Google Maps word above feedback; their fallback link is labelled Open map. GoogleReview source actions are labelled View review and retain the same URI. Gallery paging/photo-tap access, existing actions/forms, and development snapshot/credit validation remain.
discoveryPatterns.menus: Matched photo cards have an independent Menu chip at the upper left. A full Menu CTA sits below Save/Directions/Share/Call in branch details and opens /menu/[id], with flat selected-item/price rows, source and checked date. Unknown prices/currency and availability/ingredient uncertainty stay visible. Existing native stack Back, Save and gallery behavior remain. Menu source opens separately on web with explicit new-tab attributes; native uses external opening with failure feedback. Owned menu matches for typed name/branch/postal remain reachable when Google is empty or unavailable, without additional filter steps. Allium-free remains the Google keyword filter, and private Home/Work behavior is unchanged. Consumer Menu reuses Nunito and the existing semantic card, accent, action-gradient, divider and foreground tokens. The upper-left compact Menu control has a 48-unit minimum target, 28-unit radius and full focus perimeter; the detail CTA below the primary actions has a 52-unit minimum target and 16-unit radius. The separate Menu screen uses a 16-unit horizontal inset, flat item rows with a 50-unit minimum and 12-unit vertical padding, right-aligned tabular prices capped at 43% width, and 48-unit source links. Existing native Back and platform-adapted external-source behavior remain. Card information, including hours, now has 12-unit horizontal padding; top8/bottom2, divider-to-hours6 and hours-to-bottom8 remain. No new identity, token palette or CSS-detector pass is introduced.

marketplacePatterns.presentationBoundary: Marketplace-authored UI no longer uses Preview wording or a replacement badge. marketplacePatterns.ingredientEvidence: Publishing, resuming and browse eligibility require the full packaging ingredient text, an ingredient-label photo and seller confirmation that Contains/May contain choices were checked against that label. The compact editor groups the label tile, required text, eight common choices plus More ingredients (20 total) and confirmation. Eggs and Milk / dairy are separate. Changing text, label photo or tags clears confirmation. Drafts may be incomplete, but the shared 5,000-character limit produces an explicit save/publish error rather than truncating typed input; hydration of overlong stored text clears confirmation. Details retain raw text, seller-declared tags and the uncropped ingredient photo. Ingredients to avoid hides either contains or may-contain matches; there is no include-unknown option because incomplete listings are universally ineligible.
marketplacePatterns.sampleEligibility: All six fictional marketplace samples are unreviewed and have no fabricated ingredient-label photos. They are excluded from eligible browse and seller-profile feeds; direct sample details remain readable with purchase actions disabled. narrative.overview:
QuinTaste inherits the supplied UI/UX PDF: pale peach backgrounds, charcoal text, rounded near-white cards, heavy Nunito headings and a smiling dumpling chef. The visual language is warm and welcoming while discovery, local pantry marketplace, private collections, cooking and account screens prioritize food, clear choices and native navigation.

Coral & Peach is the default family. Cobalt & Turquoise and Lavender & Frost reuse the same components, geometry and semantic roles. Extend this system from the shipped tokens and components rather than creating another visual identity.
keyCharacteristics: Soft food-inspired color and a transparent raster dumpling chef.
Heavy rounded headings above readable, scalable body text.
Near-white cards with full perimeter edges and quiet shadows.
Compact task controls and progressive disclosure, with readable evidence and private-save feedback.
Immediate appearance previews with deliberate local saves.

rules.name: Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: Read colors from themeFor; component styles use semantic theme roles in every palette and display mode.

rules.name: Readable Heading Rule
rules.body: Keep enlarged headings flexible and allow wrapping; the shared title uses minWidth: 0 and flexShrink: 1.

rules.name: Compact Flow Rule
rules.body: Keep one free-text Place or postal code field with suggestions after typing, followed by Filters and the Search by my location crosshair in Explore’s single row. Keep Me on Cook/Social/Market/Game, diet choices inside Filters and root headings titleless; use 4-unit Explore content insets and 8-unit insets on other screens and retain 48-unit interaction targets.

rules.name: Perimeter Rule
rules.body: Use complete component borders. Directional accent rails are forbidden; full-width functional dividers remain allowed.

dos: Do reuse the shipped semantic tokens, text wrapper, cards, fields and controls.
Do preserve guest entry, explicit local-preview feedback and independent ingredient switches.
Do let small screens scroll and retain every action at enlarged text sizes.
Do use the existing chef asset and preserve its transparent background.

Do pair fit colors with text and icons. Cook keeps conflicts and unknown exclusions visible and discloses bundled/unreviewed provenance plus illustrative imagery through one-tap Recipe info; other evidence surfaces retain their relevant disclosures.
Do keep white single-line 18/12 text directly on photos, soften the raster from the measured name midpoint and retain compact Google source/full exact-photo credits.

Do keep one Explore search row and five icon-only glass tabs (Explore/Cook/Social/Market/Game) with accessible names, small themed selection/hover lenses, safe areas and the dock transparency fallback.
Do keep provider business reviews separate from independent ingredient evidence and preserve author/source links.
Do keep primary actions visible and reveal secondary choices through Filters or More without shrinking touch targets.
Do save and apply filter selections immediately, pair Vegetarian's carrot with Vegan's sprout, and use single-line tail ellipsis for compact landscape metadata.
donts: Don't hardcode component colors or substitute palette-specific utility colors.
Don't replace the approved chef asset, Nunito character or rounded surfaces.
Don't imply real account creation, connected account providers or allergen safety.
Don't add a pale information panel, blur text/UI, restore visible tab words or use a large glowing capsule/opaque dock host.
Don't treat illustrative venue hours, photos or draft receipts as live public facts.
Don't present search-match counts or Google categories as exhaustive venue totals or ingredient confirmation.
Don't repeat Places, Cook or Market headings above already-labelled tab roots, or add a redundant heading to the Saved toolbar.
